FOUR-NODE DEEPSEEK · TP4

Four X5 nodes. DeepSeek TP4.

Connect four X5-T5000 units through a compatible optical network to run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 with tensor parallelism (TP4). Code, chat and long-input results below are all from the four-node deployment.

Benchmark note　TPS means tokens per second under the stated test configuration. Single-stream decode and 8-way aggregate throughput measure different workloads; each card gives the prefill input length. Dual-node and four-node results are not single-node results. Figures come from the latest user-supplied test log and were not rerun for this poster. Results vary with model build, quantization, context, concurrency and deployment.
Compute at home. Capability everywhere.

2,070T is the theoretical FP4 sparse peak; 128 GB is unified CPU/GPU memory per node. 100Gbps is the maximum aggregate 4×25GbE optical link rate, not model throughput. Multi-node inference requires suitable runtimes, optics, cabling and network configuration.
